**Repos:**
- SMS project: https://github.com/doldecomp/sms
- Reference: https://github.com/zeldaret/oot-gc

The general idea is: clone the SMS repo, set it up, use oot-gc's version of `notify.c` as a starting point, and verify the match with objdiff before submitting a PR.

Has anyone worked on this unit before? Any tips would be appreciated! 🙌
